client_capacity_profiles.assignment: Balanced tier IDs are shuffled once with seed+73021 and reused across paired strategies and every round; full supernet width is reserved for the FedAvg/FedProx/SCAFFOLD reference.
client_capacity_profiles.dynamic_capacity_diagnostic: cc_efl_dynamic only; excluded from the fixed-device primary analysis.

selection: Validation metric only; for each fixed client capacity, select the smallest feasible FLOP tier within 0.2 percentage points of the best validation score.
test_set: After final training, evaluate the pre-defined tier set once for final reporting. Never evaluate test metrics during training rounds.

matched_controls.cc_efl_no_prox: Remove FedProx while keeping other CC-EFL components.
matched_controls.cc_efl_uniform: Replace largest-tier priorities with uniform aggregation weights.
matched_controls.cc_efl_random_window: Keep the per-client capacity map and resource budget fixed; sample channel offsets with seed+91237 instead of systematic rolling.

optimizer_matched_scaffold_study.optimizer: SGD with the same dataset learning rate and momentum=0.9 for all three strategies
optimizer_matched_scaffold_study.reason: The primary comparison uses Adam; SCAFFOLD uses SGD control variates, so compare it separately against FedAvg and FedProx under matched SGD rather than mixing optimizer settings.

exploratory_extensions.change: Add FjORD-style ordered-width local self-distillation to CC-EFL while preserving fixed client capacities and rolling channel windows.
exploratory_extensions.status: Exploratory; retain only if paired multi-seed comparisons support it.

exploratory_extensions.change: Use prefix windows for the first 20% of rounds, then systematic rolling windows, with FjORD-style local self-distillation.
exploratory_extensions.status: Exploratory; motivated by the corrected Digits/Adult/Bank/HAR result pattern, not part of the primary preregistered matrix.

aggregation.coordinate_update: For each global parameter coordinate, use the sample-count and priority weighted mean over only clients that updated that coordinate; preserve the previous server coordinate if no client updated it.
aggregation.largest_tier_priority: beta_r=0.2+0.35*(1+cos(pi*r/max(rounds-1,1))); a largest active tier receives beta_r and all other tiers receive 1-beta_r.
aggregation.window_offset: For a fixed tier, offset=(round_id+client_id) mod (hidden_dim-width+1); every client visits every valid bounded window start once per full cycle.

resource_metrics: selected deployed parameters per client capacity
selected deployed per-example forward FLOPs per client capacity
upload and download payload bytes per round and full run

security.secure_aggregation: pairwise X25519 mask cancellation harness; no dropout recovery
security.differential_privacy: client-level update clipping plus Gaussian noise; conservative sequential epsilon

reproduction_note: Do not report capped CIFAR pilot accuracy as a final claim; use the larger CIFAR command in README for the paper run.
